raw.description: 战斗开始时，自身消耗20%的体力上限并提升自身的其他能力值等量的数值，然后自身记录自身的体力上限，之后本场战斗自身登场时，若对手的体力上限低于此记录值，令对手的体力上限增加20%并减少其他能力值等量的数值|自身进入异常状态时，若此异常状态位于自身异常状态抗性的1号位，则自身恢复所有技能PP值，若此异常状态位于自身异常状态抗性的2号位，则对手下回合属性技能无效，若此异常状态位于自身异常状态的3号位，则对手下回合攻击技能无效|战斗阶段结束时，自身恢复最大体力的1/4，上述效果每满足过1次效果提升1/4，溢出的恢复量转化为等量的[color=#57c975]临时体力上限[/color]，最高不超过自身战斗开始时所记录数值，未溢出时下回合自身以最优系别计算受到的攻击伤害与造成的攻击伤害|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4]战斗开始时，自身消耗20%的体力上限并提升自身的其他能力值等量的数值，[color=#52a5f2]然后[/color]自身记录自身的体力上限，[color=#52a5f2]之后[/color]本场战斗自身[color=#57c975]登场[/color]时，若[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color]的体力上限低于此记录值，令[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color]的体力上限增加20%并减少其他能力值等量的数值|[sprite name=dot4]自身进入[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]时，若此[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]位于自身[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]抗性的1号位，则自身恢复所有技能PP值，若此[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]位于自身[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]抗性的2号位，则[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color]下回合属性[color=#52a5f2]技能无效[/color]，若此[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]位于自身[color=#52a5f2]异常状态[/color]的3号位，则[color=#52a5f2]对手[/color]下回合攻击[color=#52a5f2]技能无效[/color]|[sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]战斗阶段结束时[/color]，自身恢复最大体力的1/4，上述效果每满足过1次效果提升1/4，溢出的恢复量转化为等量的临时体力上限，最高叠加至自身战斗开始时所记录数值，未溢出时下回合自身以[color=#57c975]最优系别[/color]计算受到的攻击伤害与造成的攻击伤害

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 三槽成功进入按本次在场累计，回复净量和临时增量上限依据原答；初始转换保留不计数。最优候选和冲突按用户范围及API489。
review.singleBehavior: 初始消耗20%最大HP转五项面板并记转换后上限；三槽实际进入分别回满PP/封下回属性/封下回攻击，累计只计成功新进入。战阶按最大HP*(1+次数)/4走魂印公共回复链，净溢出加临时上限并补HP，增量最多recordedMax；没有净溢出下回合攻防以当前系别及子系最优，冲突当前系别；基础伤害、等级和HP/PP事件全部保留。
review.deferredBehavior: 真正后续登场时依据已记录maxHP判定并转换对手上限及其它面板；真正离场时清本次在场累计三槽计数和临时体力上限，API536默认下场消失。当前回复和临时上限数值链全部已实现。
review.trigger: 之后本场战斗自身登场时；临时体力上限默认下场消失
futureMechanisms: 真实再次登场与当前对手
真实离场清临时最大体力和本次在场触发累计

success.name: 4921真实初始20%体力上限转五项面板等量、记录转换后上限，不伪造对手再次登场
success.assertion: test('4921真实初始20%体力上限转五项面板等量、记录转换后上限，不伪造对手再次登场',()=>{for(const maxHp of[5000,9000]){const s=make({move:10047,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp}}),f=s.fighters[0],cost=maxHp*.2;assert.equal(f.stats.maxHp,maxHp-cost);assert.equal(f.hp,maxHp-cost);for(const[k,n]of Object.entries({atk:180,spa:180,def:300,spd:300,spe:500}))assert.equal(f.stats[k],n+cost);assert.equal(f.soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,maxHp-cost);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.maxHp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stats.atk,180);}});

success.name: 4921三个真实有序抗性槽成功进入分别回满PP、次轮封属性、次轮封攻击，失败及重复刷新不触发
success.assertion: test('4921三个真实有序抗性槽成功进入分别回满PP、次轮封属性、次轮封攻击，失败及重复刷新不触发',()=>{for(const slot of[0,1,2])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10047,soul:true,loadout:[10047,22660,29390,29391,38452]});s.fighters[0].build.resistance=E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({slots:[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤',chance:0}]});const names=['中毒','烧伤','冻伤'];s.fighters[0].pp[key(22660)]=0;if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;isolated((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,names[slot],c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10047,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.events.length,immune?0:1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(22660)],!immune&&slot===0?source.moves.find(m=>m.id===22660).pp:0);if(!immune&&slot>0){const block=slot===1?'statusBlock':'attackBlock';assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].effects[block],{start:2,end:2});const move=slot===1?20117:10127,pp=s.fighters[1].pp[key(move)];isolated((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,names[slot],c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10047,move));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(move)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.events.length,1);}}});

success.name: 4921抗性三槽显式概率按公共抵抗机制生效，不能凭进入槽位触发抗住后的魂印奖励
success.assertion: test('4921抗性三槽显式概率按公共抵抗机制生效，不能凭进入槽位触发抗住后的魂印奖励',()=>{for(const chance of[0,100]){const s=make({move:10047,soul:true});s.fighters[0].build.resistance=E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({slots:[{name:'中毒',chance},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤',chance:0}]});isolated((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10047,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.events.length,chance===0?1:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],chance===0);}});

success.name: 4921完整公共回合初始转换不计抗性触发，真实基础回血1800溢出加上限并补HP
success.assertion: test('4921完整公共回合初始转换不计抗性触发，真实基础回血1800溢出加上限并补HP',()=>{const s=make({move:10047,soul:true});turn(s,10047,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.triggerCount,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,7200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries[0].requested,1800);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);});

success.name: 4921抗性有序配置兼容旧两槽、拒绝缺失概率/越界/重复，第三槽不猜默认概率
success.assertion: test('4921抗性有序配置兼容旧两槽、拒绝缺失概率/越界/重复，第三槽不猜默认概率',()=>{const legacy=E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({major:'中毒',minor:'烧伤'});assert.deepEqual(legacy,{critical:0,fixed:0,percent:0,major:'中毒',minor:'烧伤'});assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance({build:{resistance:legacy}},'中毒'),.55);for(const slots of[[{name:'中毒',chance:0}],[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤'}],[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤',chance:101}],[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'中毒',chance:0}]])assert.throws(()=>E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({slots}),/抗性|概率|重复/);});

success.name: 4921全部17招有序编译及64种子基础状态，真实2117全部17招完整结算回血溢出与初始记录
success.assertion: test('4921全部17招有序编译及64种子基础状态，真实2117全部17招完整结算回血溢出与初始记录',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,7200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries[0].requested,1800);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,7200+s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.temporaryGain);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}});

success.name: 4921已答计数仅三抗性槽成功进入，本次在场累计；初始转化与刷新免疫不计，三槽累计后按比例真实回复和溢出
success.assertion: test('4921已答计数仅三抗性槽成功进入，本次在场累计；初始转化与刷新免疫不计，三槽累计后按比例真实回复和溢出',()=>{const zero=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(zero,22660,20117);assert.equal(st(zero).triggerCount,0);assert.equal(st(zero).recoveries[0].requested,1800);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].hp,2800);assert.equal(st(zero).bestRound,2);for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});slots(s);if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){for(const n of['疲惫','失明','束缚'])c.ailment(c.t,n,c.a,false,false,3);if(!immune)for(const n of['疲惫','失明','束缚'])c.ailment(c.t,n,c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,22660,20117));const count=immune?2:3;assert.equal(st(s).triggerCount,count);assert.equal(st(s).events.length,count);assert.equal(st(s).recoveries[0].requested,1800*(1+count));if(!immune){assert.equal(st(s).temporaryGain,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8200);}turn(s,null,null);assert.equal(st(s).triggerCount,count);assert.equal(st(s).recoveries[1].triggerCount,count);}});

success.name: 4921已答净回复后溢出：差200、理论600、减半实际300，余100加上限并同步补HP；技能禁疗不封魂印，完全阻回复净量0
success.assertion: test('4921已答净回复后溢出：差200、理论600、减半实际300，余100加上限并同步补HP；技能禁疗不封魂印，完全阻回复净量0',()=>{for(const mode of['half','skill-ban','all-block']){const s=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1500},hp:1000});slots(s);if(mode==='half')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='all-block')timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'疲惫',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,22660,20117));const r=st(s).recoveries[0];assert.equal(r.requested,600);assert.equal(r.net,mode==='half'?300:mode==='all-block'?0:600);assert.equal(r.restored,mode==='all-block'?0:200);assert.equal(r.overflow,mode==='half'?100:mode==='all-block'?0:400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,mode==='half'?1300:mode==='all-block'?1200:1600);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='all-block'?1000:s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp);assert.equal(st(s).recordedMax,1200);}});

success.name: 4921已答临时增量封顶初始记录7200而非总HP7200，反复叠加到14400并同步HP，不溢出才授下一回最优
success.assertion: test('4921已答临时增量封顶初始记录7200而非总HP7200，反复叠加到14400并同步HP，不溢出才授下一回最优',()=>{const s=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true});for(const max of[9000,11250,14062,14400,14400]){turn(s,22660,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,max);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,max);assert.ok(st(s).temporaryGain<=7200);assert.equal(st(s).bestRound,undefined);}assert.equal(st(s).temporaryGain,7200);assert.equal(st(s).recoveries.at(-1).added,0);assert.equal(st(s).recordedMax,7200);});

success.name: 4921已答最优仅当前圣灵光及圣灵/光：攻击草取2、防御战斗取1，真实伤害按所选系数结算，下一回时限与冲突按当前
success.assertion:
test('4921已答最优仅当前圣灵光及圣灵/光：攻击草取2、防御战斗取1，真实伤害按所选系数结算，下一回时限与冲突按当前',()=>{const s=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[22660,10047,22661,29391,38452],bStats:{spa:9999}});s.fighters[1].type='草';turn(s,22660,20117);const control=structuredClone(s);control.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.bestRound=0;turn(s,10047,10716);turn(control,10047,10716);const events=s.optimalAffinityEvents2117.filter(e=>e.round===2);assert.equal(events.find(e=>e.sourceSide===0).chosen,2);const foeType=s.moveDefinitions[key(10716)].type;assert.equal(foeType,'战斗');assert.equal(events.find(e=>e.sourceSide===1).chosen,1);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-2*sum(control))<=1);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s,'attack',1)*3-sum(control,'attack',1)*2)<=3);s.fighters[0].hp=s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp;turn(s,22660,20117);assert.ok(st(s).recoveries.at(-1).overflow>0);turn(s,10047,20117);assert.equal((s.optimalAffinityEvents2117??[]).some(e=>e.round===4),false);
 const both=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:source,enemySoul:true,loadout:[22660,10047,22661,29391,38452],enemyLoadout:[22660,10047,14897,22661,38452],hp:1000,targetHp:1000});both.fighters[1].type='草';turn(both,22660,22660);assert.equal(st(both).bestRound,2);assert.equal(both.fighters[1].soulState.dragon2117.bestRound,2);turn(both,10047,10047);const conflict=both.optimalAffinityEvents2117.filter(e=>e.round===2);assert.equal(conflict.length,2);assert.ok(conflict.every(e=>e.conflict&&e.chosen===e.base));assert.ok(sum(both)>0&&sum(both,'attack',1)>0);

interaction.name: 4921三个真实有序抗性槽成功进入分别回满PP、次轮封属性、次轮封攻击，失败及重复刷新不触发
interaction.assertion: test('4921三个真实有序抗性槽成功进入分别回满PP、次轮封属性、次轮封攻击，失败及重复刷新不触发',()=>{for(const slot of[0,1,2])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10047,soul:true,loadout:[10047,22660,29390,29391,38452]});s.fighters[0].build.resistance=E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({slots:[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤',chance:0}]});const names=['中毒','烧伤','冻伤'];s.fighters[0].pp[key(22660)]=0;if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;isolated((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,names[slot],c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10047,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.events.length,immune?0:1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(22660)],!immune&&slot===0?source.moves.find(m=>m.id===22660).pp:0);if(!immune&&slot>0){const block=slot===1?'statusBlock':'attackBlock';assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[1].effects[block],{start:2,end:2});const move=slot===1?20117:10127,pp=s.fighters[1].pp[key(move)];isolated((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,names[slot],c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10047,move));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(move)],pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.events.length,1);}}});

interaction.name: 4921抗性三槽显式概率按公共抵抗机制生效，不能凭进入槽位触发抗住后的魂印奖励
interaction.assertion: test('4921抗性三槽显式概率按公共抵抗机制生效，不能凭进入槽位触发抗住后的魂印奖励',()=>{for(const chance of[0,100]){const s=make({move:10047,soul:true});s.fighters[0].build.resistance=E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({slots:[{name:'中毒',chance},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤',chance:0}]});isolated((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10047,20117));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.events.length,chance===0?1:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒'],chance===0);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4921完整公共回合初始转换不计抗性触发，真实基础回血1800溢出加上限并补HP',()=>{const s=make({move:10047,soul:true});turn(s,10047,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.triggerCount,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,7200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries[0].requested,1800);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9000);});

interaction.name: 4921抗性有序配置兼容旧两槽、拒绝缺失概率/越界/重复，第三槽不猜默认概率
interaction.assertion: test('4921抗性有序配置兼容旧两槽、拒绝缺失概率/越界/重复，第三槽不猜默认概率',()=>{const legacy=E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({major:'中毒',minor:'烧伤'});assert.deepEqual(legacy,{critical:0,fixed:0,percent:0,major:'中毒',minor:'烧伤'});assert.equal(E.GEAR.resistanceChance({build:{resistance:legacy}},'中毒'),.55);for(const slots of[[{name:'中毒',chance:0}],[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤'}],[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'冻伤',chance:101}],[{name:'中毒',chance:0},{name:'烧伤',chance:0},{name:'中毒',chance:0}]])assert.throws(()=>E.GEAR.normalizeResistance({slots}),/抗性|概率|重复/);});

interaction.name: 4921全部17招有序编译及64种子基础状态，真实2117全部17招完整结算回血溢出与初始记录
interaction.assertion: test('4921全部17招有序编译及64种子基础状态，真实2117全部17招完整结算回血溢出与初始记录',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,7200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries[0].requested,1800);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,7200+s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.temporaryGain);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}});

interaction.name: 4921已答计数仅三抗性槽成功进入，本次在场累计；初始转化与刷新免疫不计，三槽累计后按比例真实回复和溢出
interaction.assertion: test('4921已答计数仅三抗性槽成功进入，本次在场累计；初始转化与刷新免疫不计，三槽累计后按比例真实回复和溢出',()=>{const zero=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});turn(zero,22660,20117);assert.equal(st(zero).triggerCount,0);assert.equal(st(zero).recoveries[0].requested,1800);assert.equal(zero.fighters[0].hp,2800);assert.equal(st(zero).bestRound,2);for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});slots(s);if(immune)s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){for(const n of['疲惫','失明','束缚'])c.ailment(c.t,n,c.a,false,false,3);if(!immune)for(const n of['疲惫','失明','束缚'])c.ailment(c.t,n,c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,22660,20117));const count=immune?2:3;assert.equal(st(s).triggerCount,count);assert.equal(st(s).events.length,count);assert.equal(st(s).recoveries[0].requested,1800*(1+count));if(!immune){assert.equal(st(s).temporaryGain,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,8200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8200);}turn(s,null,null);assert.equal(st(s).triggerCount,count);assert.equal(st(s).recoveries[1].triggerCount,count);}});

interaction.name: 4921已答净回复后溢出：差200、理论600、减半实际300，余100加上限并同步补HP；技能禁疗不封魂印，完全阻回复净量0
interaction.assertion: test('4921已答净回复后溢出：差200、理论600、减半实际300，余100加上限并同步补HP；技能禁疗不封魂印，完全阻回复净量0',()=>{for(const mode of['half','skill-ban','all-block']){const s=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,aStats:{maxHp:1500},hp:1000});slots(s);if(mode==='half')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});if(mode==='skill-ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='all-block')timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'疲惫',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,22660,20117));const r=st(s).recoveries[0];assert.equal(r.requested,600);assert.equal(r.net,mode==='half'?300:mode==='all-block'?0:600);assert.equal(r.restored,mode==='all-block'?0:200);assert.equal(r.overflow,mode==='half'?100:mode==='all-block'?0:400);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,mode==='half'?1300:mode==='all-block'?1200:1600);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='all-block'?1000:s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp);assert.equal(st(s).recordedMax,1200);}});

interaction.name: 4921已答临时增量封顶初始记录7200而非总HP7200，反复叠加到14400并同步HP，不溢出才授下一回最优
interaction.assertion: test('4921已答临时增量封顶初始记录7200而非总HP7200，反复叠加到14400并同步HP，不溢出才授下一回最优',()=>{const s=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true});for(const max of[9000,11250,14062,14400,14400]){turn(s,22660,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,max);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,max);assert.ok(st(s).temporaryGain<=7200);assert.equal(st(s).bestRound,undefined);}assert.equal(st(s).temporaryGain,7200);assert.equal(st(s).recoveries.at(-1).added,0);assert.equal(st(s).recordedMax,7200);});

interaction.name: 4921已答最优仅当前圣灵光及圣灵/光：攻击草取2、防御战斗取1，真实伤害按所选系数结算，下一回时限与冲突按当前
interaction.assertion:
test('4921已答最优仅当前圣灵光及圣灵/光：攻击草取2、防御战斗取1，真实伤害按所选系数结算，下一回时限与冲突按当前',()=>{const s=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[22660,10047,22661,29391,38452],bStats:{spa:9999}});s.fighters[1].type='草';turn(s,22660,20117);const control=structuredClone(s);control.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.bestRound=0;turn(s,10047,10716);turn(control,10047,10716);const events=s.optimalAffinityEvents2117.filter(e=>e.round===2);assert.equal(events.find(e=>e.sourceSide===0).chosen,2);const foeType=s.moveDefinitions[key(10716)].type;assert.equal(foeType,'战斗');assert.equal(events.find(e=>e.sourceSide===1).chosen,1);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-2*sum(control))<=1);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s,'attack',1)*3-sum(control,'attack',1)*2)<=3);s.fighters[0].hp=s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp;turn(s,22660,20117);assert.ok(st(s).recoveries.at(-1).overflow>0);turn(s,10047,20117);assert.equal((s.optimalAffinityEvents2117??[]).some(e=>e.round===4),false);
 const both=make({move:22660,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:source,enemySoul:true,loadout:[22660,10047,22661,29391,38452],enemyLoadout:[22660,10047,14897,22661,38452],hp:1000,targetHp:1000});both.fighters[1].type='草';turn(both,22660,22660);assert.equal(st(both).bestRound,2);assert.equal(both.fighters[1].soulState.dragon2117.bestRound,2);turn(both,10047,10047);const conflict=both.optimalAffinityEvents2117.filter(e=>e.round===2);assert.equal(conflict.length,2);assert.ok(conflict.every(e=>e.conflict&&e.chosen===e.base));assert.ok(sum(both)>0&&sum(both,'attack',1)>0);

success.assertion: test('4921/1688双边任一真实清强回合成功才理论比例吸取与衰弱，免粉不减回复，旧技能禁疗先被清除后正常回复',()=>{for(const mode of['own','foe','round','empty','immune','ban']){const s=make({...row(1688),hp:1000});for(const f of s.fighters)f.effects={};if(mode==='own')s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;if(['foe','immune','ban'].includes(mode))s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(mode==='round')timer(s,0,'强化保护');if(mode==='immune'){const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,trait(f,k){return f.side===1&&k==='pinkImmune'?true:old.trait(f,k);}};try{turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}}else{if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);}assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='empty'||mode==='immune'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='empty'?1000:4000);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['衰弱'],mode!=='empty');}});

success.assertion: test('4921/40先手威力双倍与776下两回红伤双倍，58下两回必暴、843下两回全先制2均到期',()=>{const a=make(row(40)),b=make({...row(40),index:-1});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.8);for(const id of[776,58,843]){const s=make({...row(id),loadout:[22662,10047,29390,29391,38452]}),z=make({...row(id),index:-1,loadout:[22662,10047,29390,29391,38452]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);turn(z,z.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,10047,20309));turn(z,10047,20309);if(id===776){if(r<=3)assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(z)*2)<=1);else assert.equal(sum(s),sum(z));}if(id===58)assert.equal(crit,r<=3);if(id===843)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);}}});

success.assertion: test('4921全部17招有序编译及64种子基础状态，真实2117全部17招完整结算回血溢出与初始记录',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,7200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries[0].requested,1800);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,7200+s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.temporaryGain);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}});

success.assertion: test('4921/426真实40%闪避有成功失败、必中覆盖；29固定50、10/12/14三个25%独立附异',()=>{const evades=new Set(),sets=new Set();for(let n=1;n<=32;n++){const s=make({...row(426),seed:Math.imul(n,2654435761)>>>0});delete s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'];turn(s,s.auditMoveId,10127);evades.add(sum(s,'attack',1)===0);const p=make({move:14898,seed:Math.imul(n,2654435761)>>>0});turn(p,14898,20309);sets.add(Object.keys(p.fighters[1].ailments).sort().join(','));}assert.deepEqual(evades,new Set([false,true]));assert.ok(sets.size>=5);const hit=make(row(426));turn(hit,hit.auditMoveId,10127);assert.ok(sum(hit,'attack',1)>0);const s=make(row(29));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed'),50);});

success.name: 4921/40先手威力双倍与776下两回红伤双倍，58下两回必暴、843下两回全先制2均到期
success.assertion: test('4921/40先手威力双倍与776下两回红伤双倍，58下两回必暴、843下两回全先制2均到期',()=>{const a=make(row(40)),b=make({...row(40),index:-1});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.8);for(const id of[776,58,843]){const s=make({...row(id),loadout:[22662,10047,29390,29391,38452]}),z=make({...row(id),index:-1,loadout:[22662,10047,29390,29391,38452]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);turn(z,z.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,10047,20309));turn(z,10047,20309);if(id===776){if(r<=3)assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(z)*2)<=1);else assert.equal(sum(s),sum(z));}if(id===58)assert.equal(crit,r<=3);if(id===843)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);}}});

success.assertion: test('4921/40先手威力双倍与776下两回红伤双倍，58下两回必暴、843下两回全先制2均到期',()=>{const a=make(row(40)),b=make({...row(40),index:-1});turn(a,a.auditMoveId,20309);turn(b,b.auditMoveId,20309);assert.ok(sum(a)>sum(b)*1.8);for(const id of[776,58,843]){const s=make({...row(id),loadout:[22662,10047,29390,29391,38452]}),z=make({...row(id),index:-1,loadout:[22662,10047,29390,29391,38452]});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);turn(z,z.auditMoveId,20309);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){let crit;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;},()=>turn(s,10047,20309));turn(z,10047,20309);if(id===776){if(r<=3)assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(z)*2)<=1);else assert.equal(sum(s),sum(z));}if(id===58)assert.equal(crit,r<=3);if(id===843)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);}}});

success.assertion: test('4921全部17招有序编译及64种子基础状态，真实2117全部17招完整结算回血溢出与初始记录',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(H);for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recordedMax,7200);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries.length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.recoveries[0].requested,1800);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,7200+s.fighters[0].soulState.dragon2117.temporaryGain);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}});

success.assertion: test('4921/1799仅后手混乱、失败下次攻击无效源刷新，先手不发未触发补偿',()=>{for(const late of[false,true])for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1799));if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,late?null:20117);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['混乱'],late&&!immune);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.nextAttackInvalid??0,late&&immune?1:0);}});
